seo.title: 40 Portfolio Project Ideas for Web3 Marketers
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for Web3 marketers. From growth campaigns to content strategies, build a portfolio that demonstrates Web3 marketing expertise.

content.intro: Web3 marketing requires understanding crypto-native audiences and unique distribution channels. These projects help you demonstrate marketing skills in the Web3 context.
